## Dataset
- **Title:** CHED Memorandum Orders (CMO) Index (2000–2026)
- **Category:** Education
- **Source:** https://legacy.ched.gov.ph/
- **Repo:** https://github.com/kuyacarlo/ched-cmo-data
- **Files:** `data/cmo_index.csv`, `data/cmo_index.jsonl`
- **License:** CC0 (index); CHED attribution for source documents

## Description
Derived, reproducible catalog of CHED CMOs with year, number, title, heuristic category, and PDF URLs. Does not redistribute PDF binaries.
